Frequently Asked Questions

Explore the most common questions about Pokecut's free features, usage, account access, and AI editing tools.

What is Pokecut and what can I use it for?

Pokecut is an all-in-one AI photo editing platform designed for portraits, travel photos, product images, and creative content. You can remove backgrounds, erase objects, enhance quality, create collages, and customise images with stickers, text, and templates, all in one place. With Pokecut's AI image generation, you can also turn prompts into studio-grade portraits, artistic visuals, Christmas scenes, fantasy maps, marketing banners, and more in seconds.

How do I use Pokecut?

You can start by uploading a photo, choosing an AI tool, or typing a prompt in the AI generator. Pokecut will guide you into the editor, where you can preview the result, adjust the edit, and export your final image.

Is Pokecut free?

Yes, Pokecut is free to use. You can receive free credits to try out basic features, such as photo enhancement and background removal. However, usage is limited. To unlock more edits, higher resolution, and full feature access, you can go to the online store to subscribe to the Pro plan.

Can I use Pokecut without signing up?

Yes you can. Pokecut can be used directly without signing up or login.

Can I use Pokecut's AI photo editor for commercial use?

Yes, you can. Pokecut allows you to use the images generated by Pokecut's AI Image Editor and AI Image Generator for commercial purposes. But please note that if the image contains design resources not provided by Pokecut, the relevant commercial copyright is not managed by Pokecut. For more information, please refer to our Terms of Use.

How can I contact Pokecut's support?

If you have a refund request, please contact us by submitting a ticket.

What makes Pokecut better than other AI photo editing tools?

Pokecut combines AI image generation, background removal, object erasing, portrait retouching, product cleanup, and batch editing in one platform—features that usually require multiple apps. It's faster, more accurate, and optimized for both daily users and e-commerce teams. No ads, no watermarks, and no complicated learning curve.

Can Pokecut edit images in batches?

Yes. Pokecut's Batch Editing tool can process up to 50 images at once. You can batch-remove backgrounds, batch-resize for Amazon or Shopee, enhance quality, or generate uniform backdrops, ideal for merchants handling large volumes.
